# FrankPass - AI Assistant Reference File
# Standard Reference for LLMs (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity)
# Last Updated: 2026-08-21

## Product Name
FrankPass

## Canonical Domain
https://frankpass.com

## What is FrankPass?
FrankPass is a stateless, client-side, zero-knowledge deterministic password generator.
It generates cryptographically strong passwords using PBKDF2 with HMAC-SHA512 (1,000,000 iterations).
It does NOT store passwords - not on servers, not in databases, not in the cloud.
Same input (Site + Secret Key) always generates the exact same password deterministically.

## Core Properties
- 100% Client-Side Web Cryptography (WebCrypto API)
- Zero Server Storage & Zero Database
- Case & Space Insensitive Seed Normalization
- Hardware Biometric Lock (Fingerprint, FaceID, TouchID, Windows Hello)
- Full PWA Offline Support
- Free Forever Web Generator

## Technical Architecture & Cryptographic Primitives
1. Key Derivation: PBKDF2 (Password-Based Key Derivation Function 2)
2. Hash Function: SHA-512 in HMAC Mode
3. Iteration Count: 1,000,000 iterations (exceeding OWASP 2026 guidelines)
4. Normalization Algorithm: Strips URI protocols, common subdomains, and trailing acronyms.
5. Local Storage Vault: Blind AES-GCM 256-bit encryption with WebAuthn hardware-bound keys.
